evidence.note: LoRA page with 去WebUI使用, 版本详情, 推荐参数

observations.text: Community objects are typed: image posts (/imageinfo), models (/modelinfo, typed Checkpoint / LORA / 模板 with base model e.g. Illustrious, Qwen-Image, Seedream), 视频特效, 工作流 (ComfyUI), AI 应用 (/lib3 hosted ComfyUI apps such as 'flux高清放大-在线生图').

Model page (LoRA) carries 版本详情 (类型 LORA, 是否原创, 在线生成数 588.7k, 下载量, 基础算法 Illustrious, 触发词 HG2512) and 推荐参数 (推荐搭配 Checkpoint null_v15, 推荐权重 0.7, CFG 4, VAE, 高清放大算法); actions 去WebUI使用 / 加入收藏 / 会员下载; 许可范围 link 创作与商用规则说明.

Model → generation: LoRA/Checkpoint community models route to the SD WebUI (/sd) via 去WebUI使用; the consumer generator (/ai-tool/*) uses closed API models (Seedream, Seedance, Kling, Wan, Minimax) and community '风格模型' cards; image posts route to the generator via 做同款 (?fillimgid=…).

LoRA training (/pretrain) is a form: image upload (预计消耗积分 computed after upload), 参数设置 Repeat 1–50, Epoch 1–20, Learning Rate presets 1e-6…2e-4, 模型效果预览提示词, cropping (聚焦裁剪 / 中央裁剪 / 无需裁剪, 512*512/512*768/768*512), auto-captioning (BLIP / Deepbooru / 仅触发词 / 无需标注 / Llava / Joy2 / 通义千问), 训练管理 list (暂无训练任务). Some options are gated (升级会员).

/asset is the user's asset home with 团队中心 / 个人资产 tabs, date-range filter and 我的收藏; it is the only place on liblib.art resembling a 'workspace' — no project object exists on liblib.art (projects live only in LibTV).

/sd is a hosted A1111-style WebUI (checkpoint 基础算法_F.1.safetensors, VAE list, Clip Skip, sampler list Euler…LCM, Sampling Steps 1–60, Width/Height sliders, CFG scale, 面部修复, 高分辨率修复, 商用规则) and /comfy a hosted ComfyUI (新版 switch, 开始生图, credit estimate 10).
Credits (积分) and membership are shared across liblib.art and liblib.tv (same '积分 0', same 会员中心 / 开通会员 chrome, cross-storage iframe).

The LibTV canvas Agent's 特效 picker (特效广场 with authors and 商用 badge) is the same community 视频特效 catalogue surfaced on the liblib.art home tab 视频特效 — community-authored effects are consumed inside the canvas node.
